name: Mire Hound

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The mire hound makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Opportunist's Lash.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

Actions.name: Opportunist's Lash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 30 feet that is Grappled by the mire hound. *Failure:* 9 (2d8) Piercing damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Whelm
Bonus Actions.text: The mire hound whelms one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While whelmed, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the mire hound, and takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the mire hound's turns. The mire hound can have only one creature whelmed at a time. If the mire hound takes 5 damage or more in a single turn from the whelmed creature, the mire hound must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits Prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the mire hound. If the mire hound dies, a whelmed creature pulls free Prone by using 5 feet of movement.

lore: A drowned fisherman's last meal is what it wants: the mire hound hauls its catch down into the rot, then returns to the shallows to wait for the next one.

generation.userConcept: a mud-caked bog hound that drags fishermen under
generation.cite: composition after Giant Crocodile (CR 5) jaws + Giant Toad (CR 1) swallow — print swallows at LOW CR
